selection_policy: Fixed small hypothesis set. No parameter grid, ranking, auto-selection or tuning on performance.

retest.LONG: Original bullish volume breakout; subsequent candle touches broken resistance from above, closes above it and above its open; its low is above the minimum low of three completed pre-breakout bars; no intervening candle closes below broken resistance.
retest.SHORT: Original bearish volume breakout; subsequent candle touches broken support from below, closes below it and below its open; its high is below the maximum high of three completed pre-breakout bars; no intervening candle closes above broken support.
retest.stop: Original breakout opposite range edge, fixed; no tighter fitted stop.
retest.entry: Next minute after completed retest confirmation; 1R distance from retest close to original fixed stop.

context.unit: Native BTC/ETH contract units; no spot or cross-provider proxies
context.LONG: Aligned price window nonpositive while verified taker buy-minus-sell delta is positive; OI increases over same window; absolute known native funding does not exceed 0.03% per 8h equivalent threshold.
context.SHORT: Aligned price window nonnegative while verified taker buy-minus-sell delta is negative; OI increases over same window; same absolute funding crowding cap.
context.divergence_definition: Directional price-flow sign disagreement over aligned completed windows; no claim that this predicts reversal or is a confirmed swing divergence.
context.availability: Require independently recorded availability timestamps at or before signal, in addition to verified complete raw values. Later historical retrieval is not original as-of availability proof. Missing publication/availability blocks full-context strategy; no assumed timestamp can release it.

regimes.trend: Absolute first-to-last close movement divided by sum absolute successive close changes; trending if >=0.3, direction from signed movement; otherwise RANGE.
regimes.volatility: Mean true range / latest close, above fixed horizon threshold is HIGH_VOL, otherwise NORMAL_VOL; no data-fitted quantiles.
regimes.available_at: Signal close; use only completed candles.

splits_and_costs: Exactly baseline v1 chronological/walk-forward partitions, sizing, official current base-tier fee and slippage scenarios, native rounding and funding accrual assumptions; horizon-specific maximum holding purge per variant.
known_oos_limitation: All 28 days have already been inspected. These are retrospective chronological comparisons, not a pristine untouched holdout. Repeated evaluation is research only; prospective validation required.
diagnostics: Time to MFE reported as minute interval and ambiguity flag; exit OHLC extrema remain bounded, never exact fabricated paths. Post-entry returns censored at actual exit.
